name: BACH_0225
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (97%)** · Confident · Careful review

The conformal set holds Invasive only, but the second model (MUSK) disagrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 97%, InSitu 3% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.00 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive [F5] | Mostly supports; nearest InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score; associated with invasive [F3] · Validated
- **Scarce benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score; associated with invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score, spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Slightly above typical · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 3, 5, 8) · context · 95th percentile; mean area 0th percentile [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Second model (MUSK) disagrees on the top class.
- Nearest reference, BACH_0160, is InSitu (similarity 0.86).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7:** strongest tubule and benign-stroma signal; confirm benign versus in situ.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 5:** highest heatmap contribution; look for invasion versus duct-confined atypia.
3. **Region 10:** top stroma-infiltration score; look for tumor cells in stroma.
